data.title: Hull stun Man U on Premier League return
data.description: HULL, ​England - ⁠Hull City ⁠captain Lewie Coyle was ​still pinching himself after the promoted side marked their return ​to the Premier League with ‌a shock 2-0 victory over Manchester United on Saturday.

data.title: Teen girl killed in Swedish school sword attack
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Swedish police said a 17-year-old female student was the fatal victim in a sword attack at a high school where widespread tributes were paid Saturday.

data.title: Dorm demolition a safety issue, says Chiang Mai University
data.description: Chiang Mai University has defended the controversial decision to demolish the historic Ang Kaew Dormitory, saying structural assessments revealed safety concerns, while stressing its historical value will be preserved.

data.title: Veteran activist apologises after sexual assault claims surface
data.description: Veteran activist Somyot Pruksakasemsuk has apologised to a woman who accused him of sexual assault, acknowledging he misunderstood her consent and promising not to repeat such acts.

data.title: France and UK urged to press Israel on Palestinian territories
data.description: PARIS - Dozens of former French and UK diplomats on Saturday urged their governments to work together to uphold international law in the Palestinian territories, accusing Israel of seeking to “destroy” any prospect of a viable Palestinian state.

data.title: Dozens more civilians killed, kidnapped in Nigeria
data.description: JOS, Nigeria - Jihadists kidnapped and killed scores of people in an attack during Friday prayers in central Nigeria’s Niger state, survivors and lawmakers told AFP on Saturday, though some were able to escape during a clash with rival militants.

data.title: Ukraine strikes kill two children after Russia’s deadly mall attack
data.description: KYIV - A Ukrainian drone attack on Saturday hit a house in southern Russia, killing two children and injuring their parents, officials said, while at least nine people remained missing after a Russian attack on a Ukrainian shopping centre.

data.title: Nominee raids extend to three sites in Pattaya
data.description: Officials have raided three locations in Pattaya and seized computers and documents linked to a suspected nominee scheme concealing foreign ownership of land and businesses.

data.title: Airstrike on Myanmar monastery kills 14
data.description: A Myanmar military airstrike on a monastery where civilians were gathered for a meditation retreat marking Buddhist Lent has killed 14 people, two rebel fighters who witnessed the aftermath said.

data.title: Gen Z fuels growth in fractional and digital gold investing
data.description: YLG says younger investors are entering the gold market earlier, using mobile platforms for smaller purchases and regular long-term accumulation

data.title: War weapons from Cambodia seized in Trat
data.description: A smuggling suspect has been arrested and two AK-47 rifles, more than 24,000 rounds of ammunition and other items smuggled from Cambodia seized at a pier in Laem Ngop district of Trat province.

data.title: Cities compete to be Japan’s ‘backup capital’
data.description: TOKYO — For 158 years, Tokyo has stood as Japan’s glittering capital, a world-famous nexus of food, culture, business and government.

data.title: Thai Fans Urged to Back Next Representative for Miss Universe 2026
data.description: Pageant enthusiasts across Thailand are invited to rally behind the newly crowned Miss Universe Thailand 2026 as she prepares to vie for global glory

data.title: Judge strikes down Trump’s 75-country visa ban
data.description: A US federal judge has struck down the Trump administration’s ban on issuing visas to immigrants from 75 countries including Thailand, finding that the policy was “contrary to law” and beyond the legal authority of Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

data.title: The Dawn of Smart Healthcare: How Thailand is Deploying AI and Robotics to Bridge Regional Healthcare Gaps
data.description: The Ministry of Public Health pioneers cutting-edge AI, autonomous medical robots, and seamless digital systems to ensure world-class care for all

data.title: Flood-weary Nan braces for more rain on Sunday
data.description: Authorities are closely monitoring the Nan River basin as water levels begin to stabilise and recede in several areas, while preparing for more rain forecast to hit the flood-weary northern province on Sunday.

data.title: Bangkok finds more houses crowded with ‘pink card’ holders
data.description: Thirteen households across nine districts in Bangkok have been found to have at least 16 migrant residents with pink ID cards registered at each address, prompting authorities to launch case‑by‑case investigations.

data.title: Suspect held after body pulled from Benjasiri Park pond
data.description: A homeless man was arrested on Saturday morning after another man was found dead in a pond at Benjasiri Park in Klong Toey district of Bangkok.

data.title: Industrial waste fires in Rayong ‘violated human rights’
data.description: <p>The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC) has found that repeated fires at an industrial waste storage facility in Rayong violated residents' right to a healthy environment and exposed gaps in factory legislation.</p>

data.title: American woman in Thailand held for son's abduction
data.description: <p>An American woman wanted for alleged parental kidnapping in the United States has been arrested in Bangkok after nearly two years in hiding with her son, Thai police said.</p>

data.title: New illegal waste dumping task force set up
data.description: <p>The Pollution Control Department (PCD) plans to establish a ministry-level task force to tackle illegal industrial waste dumping after links have emerged across several eastern provinces.</p>

data.title: Cancer screening centre planned at new MRT station
data.description: <p>The Transport and Public Health ministries have launched a project to turn space at an Orange Line station into a preventive health centre, making cancer screening more accessible by public transport.</p>

data.title: Man found dead in pond at Benjasiri Park in Bangkok
data.description: An unidentified man was found dead in a pond at Benjasiri Park in Klong Toey district of Bangkok late Friday night.

data.title: Vigilance stressed along Thai-Cambodian border
data.description: <p>Thailand has been closely monitoring the situation along the Cambodian border and remains on alert, said ACM Prapas Sornchaidee, director of the Joint Information Center on the Thailand-Cambodia Situation (JIC).</p>

data.title: House committee rejects Student Loan Fund top-up
data.description: <p>The House committee scrutinising the fiscal 2027 budget bill has approved the reallocation of 11.16 billion baht to nine agencies, rejecting a People's Party proposal to provide additional funding for the Student Loan Fund (SLF).</p>

data.title: Vitafoods Asia 2026: Thailand’s nutraceutical market enters a new growth era
data.description: Growing consumer demand for preventive health and personalised nutrition is creating new opportunities across Asia — with Thailand emerging as a strategic hub for the region’s nutraceutical industry.
